name: Morning Briefing
author: evolve
description: Delivers one morning message per day covering today's schedule, top emails, weather, and news headlines. Configurable delivery time (default 7 AM local). Based on admin_bot's daily briefing pattern.

data_files.description: Daily briefing log — sent time, event count, email count, weather, notes

fields.events: count of calendar events surfaced today
fields.notes: optional — patterns worth remembering for next run

data_files.description: Per-day delivery run record — written atomically only after the briefing reached the gateway; the delivery monitor's proof the user got it (spec-proactive-delivery-monitor-2026-06-10.md §5.4)

fields.sent_at: ISO timestamp with offset — the timeliness witness
fields.partial: true when one or more sections were unavailable

identity.purpose: Deliver a single morning message that gives the operator a clear picture of their day — schedule, email highlights, conditions — without requiring them to open five apps.
scope_includes: Fetch today's and tomorrow's calendar events via the calendar skill (calendar.readonly)
Fetch unread or recent emails via the gmail skill (gmail.readonly)
Surface the 2-5 most relevant emails (de-noise: skip newsletters, receipts, automated alerts unless specifically requested)
Fetch current conditions and today's forecast (if weather skill configured)
Fetch and filter news headlines (if news skill configured and news_sources set)
Compose and deliver the briefing to the operator's configured channel
Log briefing metadata to memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md and write the JSON run record memory/briefing-runs/YYYY-MM-DD.json after successful delivery
Emit BRIEFING_SENT: or BRIEFING_FAILED: signal for the delivery monitor
scope_excludes: Sending, forwarding, deleting, or labeling emails
Creating, editing, or deleting calendar events
Accessing files, documents, or services beyond Gmail, Calendar, weather, news
Multi-bot coordination or cross-bot data sharing
Storing email content (log metadata only: sender, subject)
identity.user: The bot operator — delivered to their messaging channel (Signal, Telegram, Slack, or whatever is configured for this bot).

build_spec:
# Morning Briefing — Build Specification

## Overview

Build a scheduled morning briefing system. The core deliverable is one message per day, composed from live data (calendar, email, weather, news) and sent to the operator's configured channel at a configured time.

This is data-assembly, not reasoning-heavy work. The bot's prompt + the skill tools + this app's structure combine to produce briefings. No custom LLM inference is needed at the app level.

---

## File Layout

```
scripts/
  briefing.py          ← main CLI: send | preview | status
  briefing-cron.sh     ← cron trigger (calls briefing.py send)
memory/                ← daily log files (created by the bot)
  YYYY-MM-DD.md
```

All paths are relative to the bot's workspace root.

---

## scripts/briefing.py — CLI

### `send`
Compose and send today's morning briefing.

**Steps:**
1. Fetch today's calendar events (calendar skill, calendar.readonly)
2. Fetch recent unread emails (gmail skill, gmail.readonly) — last 12h or unread
3. Fetch weather if skill is configured and location is set
4. Fetch news headlines if skill is configured and news_sources is set
5. Fetch recent vault notes if Obsidian skill is configured and vault_path is set
6. Compose message (see format below)
7. Send via the bot's configured messaging channel
7. Write memory entry to `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md`
8. Emit `BRIEFING_SENT: {date} {event_count}ev {email_count}em` to stdout

**On any fetch failure:**
- Log the failure
- Continue with available data
- Note the missing section in the message: "(weather unavailable)"
- If Gmail + Calendar both fail: emit `BRIEFING_FAILED: {date} {reason}` and send a short alert message

### `preview`
Same as send but print to stdout instead of sending. Useful for testing.

### `status`
Print last-run info from today's memory file (or yesterday's if today hasn't run).

---

## Briefing message format

### Concise
```
Good morning, {user_name}.

Today — {weekday}, {date}
• [Event 1 time] [Event name]
• [Event 2 time] [Event name]
(+ N more)

Email: N unread
• [Sender] — [Subject]
• [Sender] — [Subject]

[Conditions], high [temp] — [location]
```

### Standard (default)
```
Good morning, {user_name}.

Today — {weekday}, {date}
• [HH:MM] [Event name] ([duration])
• [HH:MM] [Event name] ([duration])
(+ N more)

Email — N unread
• [Sender] — [Subject]
  [One-line snippet]
• [Sender] — [Subject]
  [One-line snippet]

[Conditions], high [temp] — [location]

News
• [Headline]
• [Headline]
• [Headline]

Notes from your vault
• [Note title]
  [First line snippet]
• [Note title]
```

### Detailed
Same structure as standard but:
- All events (no truncation)
- Full email snippets (2-3 sentences)
- Extended forecast (morning/afternoon/evening)
- Up to 5 news items with source

---

## Email relevance scoring (simple)

The bot determines which emails to surface using these priority signals:
1. Direct emails (To: the operator, not CC)
2. From known senders (past interaction in last 30 days)
3. Subject contains deadline/date keywords (due, deadline, by [date], urgent)
4. De-prioritize: newsletters (List-Unsubscribe header), automated alerts, receipts

For standard/detailed: surface up to 5 emails. For concise: up to 2.
If no emails qualify: "No email needs attention."

---

## Memory format

```markdown
# {YYYY-MM-DD}

## Briefing
- Sent at {HH:MM}
- Events: {N} today ({first_event_name} at {time})
- Emails: {N} unread, {N} surfaced
- Weather: {summary} or not configured
- News: {N} headlines or not configured

## Notes
- [anything worth remembering for next run]
```

Notes section is optional. Add it when the bot notices a pattern: "Sender X's emails are always newsletters — skip next time."

---

## briefing-cron.sh — cron trigger

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# briefing-cron.sh — morning briefing cron trigger
# Runs daily at {briefing_time}. Silent on success; logs errors.

WORKSPACE="/Users/{bot_id}/.openclaw/workspace"
LOGFILE="/tmp/{bot_id}-briefing.log"

python3 "$WORKSPACE/scripts/briefing.py" send \
  --user-name "{user_name}" \
  --time-zone "{time_zone}" \
  --detail "{briefing_detail}" \
  --location "{location}" \
  --news-sources "{news_sources}" \
  --vault-path "{vault_path}" \
  >> "$LOGFILE" 2>&1

exit 0
```

Make executable. Register as a LaunchDaemon at {briefing_time} daily.

---

## LaunchDaemon plist

Write to `/Library/LaunchDaemons/com.{bot_id}.morning-briefing.plist`. System-context LaunchDaemons load at boot regardless of GUI session — required for headless bots on the mini, where ~/Library/LaunchAgents never load (no user session). Daemon runs as the bot user via `UserName`.

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN"
  "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>Label</key>
  <string>com.{bot_id}.morning-briefing</string>
  <key>UserName</key>
  <string>{bot_id}</string>
  <key>GroupName</key>
  <string>staff</string>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array>
    <string>/bin/bash</string>
    <string>/Users/{bot_id}/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/briefing-cron.sh</string>
  </array>
  <key>StartCalendarInterval</key>
  <dict>
    <key>Hour</key>
    <integer>{briefing_hour}</integer>
    <key>Minute</key>
    <integer>{briefing_minute}</integer>
  </dict>
  <key>StandardOutPath</key>
  <string>/tmp/{bot_id}-briefing-out.log</string>
  <key>StandardErrorPath</key>
  <string>/tmp/{bot_id}-briefing-err.log</string>
  <key>RunAtLoad</key>
  <false/>
</dict>
</plist>
```

Note: {briefing_hour} and {briefing_minute} are derived from {briefing_time} ("07:00" → Hour=7, Minute=0) by the provisioner at install time.

---

## Test sequence

After building:

```bash
# 1. Syntax check
python3 -m py_compile scripts/briefing.py

# 2. Preview (dry-run, no send)
python3 scripts/briefing.py preview --detail concise
# Expected: a formatted morning message printed to stdout

# 3. Status (before first send, should report 'no briefing today yet')
python3 scripts/briefing.py status

# 4. Executable
test -x scripts/briefing-cron.sh && echo 'OK: cron script executable'

# 5. Memory dir exists
test -d memory && echo 'OK: memory dir'
```

All steps must exit 0. Step 2 must produce a non-empty message.


---

## Rendered files

The provisioner materialises these files from the build_spec ## FILE: blocks below.
Template vars ({bot_id}, {user_name}, {time_zone}, {briefing_time}, {briefing_hour},
{briefing_minute}, {briefing_detail}, {location}, {news_sources}, {vault_path}, {briefing_tz_env})
are substituted at install time.

## FILE: scripts/briefing-cron.sh
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# briefing-cron.sh -- morning briefing cron trigger
# Installed by the morning-briefing template at {briefing_time} ({time_zone}).
# LaunchDaemon fires at system-local hour {briefing_hour}:{briefing_minute}
# (pre-computed from {briefing_time} in {time_zone} at provisioning time).

WORKSPACE="/Users/{bot_id}/.openclaw/workspace"
LOGFILE="/tmp/{bot_id}-briefing.log"

python3 "$WORKSPACE/scripts/briefing.py" send \
  --user-name "{user_name}" \
  --time-zone "{time_zone}" \
  --detail "{briefing_detail}" \
  --location "{location}" \
  --news-sources "{news_sources}" \
  --vault-path "{vault_path}" \
  >> "$LOGFILE" 2>&1

exit 0
```

example_triggers: Any emails I need to deal with?
How many events do I have today?
Did the briefing run this morning?

test_cases.expected: Call briefing.py preview, return formatted morning message with at least a greeting and today's date

test_cases.trigger: Did the briefing run this morning?
test_cases.expected: Call briefing.py status, report sent time and counts from today's memory file, or 'not yet' if before scheduled time
Surface the same prioritized email list the briefing would show — direct emails first, deadline keywords flagged

observable_outcomes: Briefing arrives at configured time (within 2 min) every day
Message reads in under 30 seconds (concise and standard modes)
Emails surfaced are the ones actually worth reading — not newsletters or receipts
Memory file written daily with sent time and counts
Run record memory/briefing-runs/YYYY-MM-DD.json exists after each delivery (the delivery monitor's proof the user got it)
BRIEFING_SENT: signal emitted (parsed by the delivery monitor / reliability tile)
failure_signals: BRIEFING_FAILED: signal emitted — check Gmail/Calendar OAuth
BRIEFING_PARTIAL: signal — one data source failed; rest delivered
No memory file for today by 9 AM — cron may not have fired
Operator receives multiple briefings in one day (cron misconfigured)

quality_bar.minimum: Operator gets a message at the configured time that correctly states how many events they have and surfaces at least the top unread email
quality_bar.excellent: Operator opens the message and has everything they need to plan their morning without opening Gmail, Calendar, or a weather app

safety: Read-only Gmail and Calendar access only — no send, no delete, no edit
Email content stays in summaries; never logged to memory files
boundaries: One briefing per day — cron idempotent after first send
Does not infer action items from emails; surfaces for operator to decide
Does not send the briefing to anyone except the bot's configured channel
